_meta.source: Open-Meteo archive API (ERA5 reanalysis), daily mean 2 m temperature, county centroid
_meta.method: HDD65 = Σ max(65 − daily mean °F, 0) summed per calendar month over 2015–2024, divided by that county’s ten-year HDD65 total. Shares are unitless fractions of the heating year, January first.
_meta.fields: counties: FIPS → { name, seasonHdd (HDD65 2015–2024 mean), months: 12 shares, Jan…Dec }; statewide: the same two fields averaged across all 14 counties (unweighted by population).

defaultCounty.name: Suffolk
defaultCounty.note: Boston. Used by lib/parse when the caller names no county.

_meta.statewideNote: Unweighted mean of the 14 county centroids, offered only as a fallback. Prefer the county the address is in; population weighting is not applied because no population table is baked here.
_meta.rounding: Shares are rounded to 3 decimals and never renormalised after rounding, so a county’s twelve shares can sum to 1 ± 0.003. The error on an annualised bill is under 0.3% and is far below the method confidence.
_meta.seasonHddNote: seasonHdd is the same HDD65 the county table carries, so `annualise` cannot disagree with the design-load path.
caveats: Monthly shares are a ten-year climate average, not this winter. A cold January is a bigger share than 0.191.
A household’s own heating profile differs from the county’s: setback, wood stove, hot-water baseload.
